review.description: Adopt safe release transitions, rollback, data-retaining uninstall and truthful diagnostics in S1-S4.
review.implementation: Reviewed lifecycle backups/operation recovery/profile restoration, scoped Tailscale route ownership and version-bound evidence. This change executes packaged/service fixtures only and does not modify running user services.
review.tests: Packaged installer, gateway profile archive/rollback, route ownership and version-bound evidence fixtures are required local checks. Real logout/login, installed host soak/CSP/callbacks stay open; deployed probes and rootless systemd checks are referenced as opt-in.
